import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int N;
    static char[][] mat;
    static char[][] mat2;
    static int[][] v1;
    static int maxN = 110;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cost, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostMaxFlow {
        int Nodes;
        int[] cost, flow, p;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges;
        int tot_cost, tot_flow;

        MinCostMaxFlow() {
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        int getFlow() {
            return tot_flow;
        }

        int getCost() {
            return tot_cost;
        }

        void clear(int n) {
            maxN = Nodes = n;
            cost = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(cost, INF);
            flow = new int[n];
            p = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cost, int flow) {
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, cost, flow));
            edges.add(new Edge(to, from, -cost, 0));
        }

        void getPath(int src, int sink) {
            clear(maxN);
            flow[src] = INF;
            cost[src] = 0;
            boolean updated;
            for (int i = 0; i < Nodes && (updated = false) == false; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(j);
                    if (e.flow > 0 && cost[e.to] > cost[e.from] + e.cost) {
                        int newCost = cost[e.from] + e.cost;
                        if (newCost < cost[e.to]) {
                            cost[e.to] = newCost;
                            flow[e.to] = Math.min(flow[e.from], e.flow);
                            p[e.to] = j;
                            updated = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (!updated) break;
            }
        }

        void costFlow(int src, int sink) {
            if (src == sink) {
                tot_cost = 0;
                tot_flow = INF;
                return;
            }
            tot_cost = 0;
            tot_flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                getPath(src, sink);
                if (flow[sink] == 0) break;
                for (int cur = sink; cur != src; cur = edges.get(p[cur]).from) {
                    int rI = p[cur] % 2 == 0 ? p[cur] + 1 : p[cur] - 1;
                    edges.get(p[cur]).flow -= flow[sink];
                    edges.get(rI).flow += flow[sink];
                    tot_cost += edges.get(p[cur]).cost * flow[sink];
                }
                tot_flow += flow[sink];
            }
        }
    }

    static void ff(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(x * N + y);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int cx = cur / N;
            int cy = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[i];
                int ny = cy + dy[i];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= N || ny < 0 || ny >= N || v[nx][ny] != -1 || mat[nx][ny] == 'Y')
                    continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2[nx][ny]) && mat2[nx][ny] != '0' && (v[cx][cy] + 1 <= v1[nx][ny] || v1[nx][ny] == -1)) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[cx][cy] + 1;
                    if (v[nx][ny] != v1[nx][ny])
                        q.add(nx * N + ny);
                } else if (v1[nx][ny] == -1 || v1[nx][ny] > v[cx][cy] + 1) {
                    v[nx][ny] = v[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q.add(nx * N + ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void ini(int x, int y, int[][] v) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                v[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        v[x][y] = 0;
        ff(x, y, v);
    }

    static int[][][] computeDistances(char[][] m) {
        int size = N * N;
        int[][][] dist = new int[size][][];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m[i][j]) && m[i][j] != '0') {
                    int k = i * N + j;
                    dist[k] = new int[N][N];
                    ini(i, j, dist[k]);
                } else {
                    dist[k] = null;
                }
            }
        }
        return dist;
    }

    static int in(int a) {
        return 2 * a;
    }

    static int out(int a) {
        return 2 * a + 1;
    }

    static MinCostMaxFlow mcf = new MinCostMaxFlow();

    static void addEdge(int i, int j, int x, int y) {
        int n1 = i * N + j;
        int n2 = x * N + y + N * N;
        mcf.addEdge(out(n1), in(n2), 0, 1000000);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int t = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.nextLine();
        N = n;
        mat = new char[n][n];
        mat2 = new char[n][n];
        int si = 0, sj = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (mat[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = scanner.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                mat2[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        int[][] v = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v[i], -1);
        v1 = new int[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(v1[i], INF);
        ini(si, sj, v);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(v[i], 0, v1[i], 0, N);
        }

        int[][][] vv = computeDistances(mat);

        mcf.clear(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; i++) {
            mcf.addEdge(src, in(i), 0, 1000000);
            mcf.addEdge(out(N * N + i), src + 1, 0, 1000000);
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(mat[x][y])) {
                    int k = x * N + y;
                    mcf.addEdge(in(k), out(k), 0, mat[x][y] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2[x][y])) {
                    int k = x * N + y + N * N;
                    mcf.addEdge(in(k), out(k), 0, mat2[x][y] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(mat2[i][j]) && mat2[i][j] != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < vv.length; k++) {
                        if (vv[k] != null) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (vv[k][i][j] != -1 && vv[k][i][j] <= t) {
                                addEdge(x, y, i, j);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mcf.costFlow(src, src + 1);
        System.out.println(mcf.getFlow());
    }
}
